text:
alex: Holding release window — staging pipeline failed while fetching cached layers for artifacts, looks like a cache-lease stall + checksum mismatch. Deploybot retried but keeps 502/invalid-checksum on artifact fetch. :grimacing:
priya: Can you paste the deploy-bot output?
alex: logs from deploy-bot:
```
[deploy-bot] GET https://storage.company-artifacts/staging/artifact-2026-03-21.tar.gz -> 502
[deploy-bot] retrying (lease=locked)
[deploy-bot] fetched blob, sha256 != expected (expected=3b2f..., got=7f1a...)
[deploy-bot] cache-lease: leaseid=lk_42 timed out after 30s
```
deploy-bot: promote blocked: artifact integrity check failed, manual intervention required (attempts=5) :rotating_light:
mike: I saw a partial multipart upload earlier today that might explain a truncated object. I can re-run the upload and re-compute the digest. Do we want to pin to last-good digest and force-promote, or wait for reupload?
julia: If we force-promote we risk serving a bad artifact. I'd prefer pin+manual promote after verified reupload. We should minimize change-window duration.
priya: Agree with pin+verify. Can we route traffic to the previous image digest as a graceful-deg fallback while we sort artifacts?
alex: Yes — Ops: can we flip routing to previous digest (sha256:aa11bb...) for the next hour, then attempt manual promote when mike confirms new artifact? @deploy-bot can you hold the auto-promote?
deploy-bot: auto-promote suspended for release id=R-2026-03-21-1 by request from alex. Current state: blocked -> waiting-manual. To resume: `/deploybot resume R-2026-03-21-1` after verification.
mike: Upload started: `gsutil -m cp -n part-* gs://company-artifacts/staging/` doing post-upload verify with `sha256sum`. Will ping when done.
julia: Also add cache invalidation step: delete cache key for that artifact to avoid stale served chunks. I can run the invalidation script after mike finishes.
priya: Who's owner for release notes and customer comms in this window? We should note brief blurb: "Short delay due to artifact verification; rolling back to previous image for safety; expecting <30m."
alex: I'll draft the note and send to #release-announcements once we confirm failover. Action items: mike reupload + verify, julia invalidate cache, deploy-bot stay suspended, alex send comms, priya monitor smoke tests on previous digest.
mike: reupload complete, sha256 matches 3b2f... now. Pushing to staging, then requesting a quick verify run.
julia: invalidation done (cache-key: staging/artifact-2026-03-21.tar.gz).
deploy-bot: manual promote request received. pre-promote smoke run queued.
priya: smoke tests green on previous digest; waiting on new artifact verification.
mike: smoke run on new artifact green locally, requesting manual promote now.
deploy-bot: manual promote accepted, promoting artifact-2026-03-21.tar.gz (sha256=3b2f...). Rolling traffic back to new digest with gradual rollout policy (5% -> 25% -> 100%).
alex: Thanks team — removing hold. I'll update release notes: short delay, pin to previous during verification, manual promote after reupload, no rollback to older app required. :thumbsup:
julia: :tada:
